W.note: Thin one-line collapsed bar with strong ARIA (switches, live region, Esc), but the opened card has a large dead gap above the footer and the collapsed row is cramped.

X.note: Clean header with progress bar, carrier and number, stops-away and action buttons, though the collapsed state shows no progress and keyboard and screen-reader support is lighter.

Y.note: Richest tracking with ETA window, progress line, locations and timestamps, copy and alert actions, plus Esc and reduced-motion support, at the cost of a taller opened card.

Z.note: Tightest footprint with a stepped dot meter, amber accent and check timeline, though the tracking number is shortened and no ETA shows when collapsed beyond 4 of 5.
